decision: The newest complete live English OSRS cache in the retrieved current public metadata is still 2695. It is selected for freshness and working decoding, not as a mandatory historical pin. Use the current original injected runtime, not the official farewell stub or a legacy build-235 downgrade.
owner_authorized_change: Complete M1, use the latest gamepacks you can find it does not need to be exactly 2695.

discovery.selection_rule: game=oldschool, environment=live, language=en; sort by timestamp then id descending; require complete indexes/groups and disk_store_valid; selected cache supplied directly by Jagex

cache.disk_store_note: The original ZIP contains 25 files. RuneLite DiskStorage additionally creates empty .idx16 and .idx23 for zero-group indexes; only these exact empty extras are allowed. All original file hashes are verified before and after integrity tests.

index_format.map_group: group ID = (regionX << 8) | regionY, file 0 terrain, file 1 locations
index_format.disk_version_trailer: low 16 bits of full 32-bit index archive revision; validate then strip before RuneLite decoding

runtime.provider: Current official RuneLite bootstrap, original injected Jagex runtime

numeric_revision_observation.method: Instantiate the actual injected client in an isolated headless JVM; set ClientConfiguration from the retrieved official configuration; call original init(); read getRevision()
numeric_revision_observation.scope: Configuration initialization only. No gameworld login, terms acceptance, personal RuneLite configuration, or source scene capture.

tooling.configured_decoder_versions: Object/NPC/sequence loaders consume their config archive revisions, not numeric game revision; interface loader consumes full index-3 revision.

compatibility_observations.observation: Current official configuration declares revision240 and the original current injected runtime returns240 after its actual initialization.

Latest cache metadata declares240; original bytes for full regions, object/NPC definitions, models, interfaces, fonts, textures, legacy frames/skeletons, music and sounds decode successfully with full selected group CRC/version checks.

Full original renderer cache loading, calibrated world/UI/audio capture and authorized in-world journey have not been observed by this task. Initialization and source-data decoding are not these acceptance gates.
